## Before I request a review

- [ ] Every changed file is inside my own top-level results folder.
- [ ] I left the shared firmware and other students' folders unchanged.
- [ ] My README includes my name, board MAC, count, every MAC heard, and the actual window date and time.
- [ ] I used results from my own board in the approved room and window.
- [ ] I waited at least 30 seconds before recording my results.
- [ ] I added a readable Serial Monitor screenshot showing the count and MAC addresses.
- [ ] I added my 30-second Serial Monitor screen recording.
- [ ] My evidence filenames use my surname, and the README links open correctly.
- [ ] The written results agree with my evidence and contain no pending values.
- [ ] I made these commits using my own GitHub account and a connected commit email.

After this pull request is merged, I will check my files in the shared
repository and submit the shared repository URL.
